severity.info: Shutdown announced more than 180 days away

confidence.high: String passed as a model, model_name, or model_id argument
confidence.medium: String literal elsewhere, such as a constant or list of model choices

limitations: Exact string literals only; f-strings, concatenation, environment variables, and config files are not resolved
Covers text, chat, reasoning, moderation, and embedding models; image, video, audio, and live models are not listed
Gemini 1.0 models and gemini-1.5-flash-8b are not listed because their dates were not confirmed from an official source
Gemini 1.5 dates come from Vertex AI documentation and Google's developer forum because the Gemini API page no longer lists them
Gemini API dates are earliest possible shutdowns; Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock, and Google-managed Claude set their own schedules
Bedrock- and Vertex-style IDs (for example anthropic.claude-...-v1:0 or claude-...@date) are not matched
The table is fixed at release; updating it requires a new apiheal release
